senses.gloss:
I. 1 P. (लयति) To melt, dissolve. --II. 9 P. (लिनाति) 
__1 To adhere. 
__2 To melt, usually with वि. -III. 4 Ā. (लीयते, लीन) 
__1 To stick or adhere firmly to, cling to. 
__2 To clasp, embrace. 
__3 To lie or rest on, recline, stay or dwell in, lurk, hide, cower down; (भृङ्गाङ्गनाः) लीयन्ते मुकुलान्तरेषु शनकैः संजातलज्जा इव [[Ratn. 1. 26]]; हरिशिशुरुत्पतितुं द्रागङ्गान्याकुञ्च्य लीयते निमृतम् [[Bv. 1. 106]]; [[R. 3. 9]]; [[Ś. 6. 16]]; [[Ku. 1. 12]]; 7. 21; [[Bk. 18. 13]]; [[Ki. 5. 26.]] 
__4 To be dissolved, melt away. 
__5 To be sticky or viscous. 
__6 To be absorbed in, be devoted or attached to; माधब मनसिजविशिखभयादिव भाबनया त्वयि लीना [[Gīt. 4.]] 
__7 To vanish, disappear. -Caus. (लापयति-ते, लाययति-ते, लीनयति-ते, लालयति-ते) To melt, dissolve, liquefy. (The form लापयते is used in the sense of ‘to honour’, ‘cause to be honoured’; जटाभिर्लापयते = पूजामधिगच्छति; cf. [[P. I. 3. 70.]]).
